digest.component_or_area: rebar store push and workflow delivery
propositions: Duplicate CAS delivery loops across workflows must be consolidated into a single Python core module to eliminate code duplication and ensure consistent retry/merge/push behavior.
The strict push delivery mode must classify failures with typed error reasons and report unpushed-commit counts to enable workflow automation to distinguish policy decline from transport failure.
Workflow automation must delegate delivery exactly once through strict Python entrypoints rather than maintaining workflow-local fetch/merge/retry loops.
Existing Python library, CLI, and MCP callers must retain best-effort default behavior while new workflow callers opt into strict delivery without breaking backward compatibility.

The locked commit-and-push operation must atomically stage, commit with specified identity/message, and deliver a single CAS transaction on the tickets-branch with deterministic recovery on non-fast-forward races.
